chunks: Sa'id ibn 'Abd Allah al-A'raj asked Abū 'Abd Allāh عليه السلام:
About an ostrich egg that I ate in the Haram, so he said: “Give in charity its price.”

key_terms.أَكَلْتُ: I ate, indicating the act that incurred liability
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary in which special rulings apply
key_terms.بِثَمَنِهَا: with its price, meaning its monetary equivalent
key_terms.تَصَدَّقْ: give in charity as expiation or compensation
key_terms.نَعَامَةٍ: ostrich, specifying the type of egg involved

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for eating an ostrich egg in the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning consuming an ostrich egg within the Haram. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that compensation be made through charity equal to its monetary value.
